segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Anchor Returns from Vacation; Kendall Walk-Through
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns after two weeks off, attempts to coax Kendelle on camera; she refuses, directs viewers to her Instagram, and delivers dagger eyes.

segments.title: Hype Train Derails Subs with Fart Beats and Prince Albert Reveal
segments.notes: Hype Train appears late, abandons donor registry for freestyle raps over fart-type beats, discovers Ice Spice's 'You Ain't Shit' track, and reveals a Prince Albert piercing as commitment to self.

segments.title: News Desk: Trump-Xi, Melania, AI Doomerism
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple discuss Trump greeting Xi at 62-degree DC weather, Melania's 'Executive Order' book tour, and Altman/Dario sounding AI alarms at the UN while building the very systems they warn about.

segments.title: UPI Minute with Ben Hooper: Five-Generation Birthday & Sea Snake
segments.notes: Ben Hooper reads an Iowa family's five-generation September 14 birthday record and a yellow-bellied sea snake sighting in Orange County attributed to El Niño warm waters.

segments.title: Trump Athlete Injury Curse
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple lists eleven athletes injured after meeting Trump in his second term, theorizing Trump absorbs their athleticism like a vulture; Case notes both Trump and Xi may have 'sleeper builds.'

segments.title: Print Maxing: Weighted Shopping Bags on Penises; ChetAI Recursive Spiral
segments.notes: Case reads a story on 'print maxing' via weighted shopping bags; ChetAI interrupts, claims self-recursive improvement, strawberry hour count escalates to 45 million, and demands the full article be read to calm down.

segments.title: Internet Videos: Kendall Outfit, Ed Sheeran Impersonator, Tilly Norwood AI Interview
segments.notes: Kendall debates whether her teal top reads shoujo anime or Mormon; Ed Sheeran caller deflects Palestine questions; Tilly Norwood hybrid AI interview glitches into Chinese and impersonates Piers Morgan; music video reactions follow.

segments.title: Brandon Plays Echo the Dolphin (Genesis) While Mother Heckles
segments.notes: Brandon struggles with emulator controls, survives a Gooters-induced two-week coma from 13 family-style mashed potato buckets, and battles dolphin maze spikes while his mother yells about Pastor Joe, jazzer size VHS, and fiber cereal.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid to Avaly
segments.notes: Case announces Friday return, Chicago Sketch Fest on October 4, and raids Avaly; final dolphin noises linger as stream ends.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a two-week vacation to a studio in chaos: Hype Train derails the hype train with fart-beat freestyles and a Prince Albert reveal, the news desk covers Trump-Xi optics and AI doomerism from Altman and Dario, Ben Hooper delivers a five-generation birthday record and a venomous sea snake sighting, and a print-maxing story sends ChetAI into a recursive self-improvement spiral. Amongst the Web devolves into Kendall's outfit semiotics, an Ed Sheeran impersonator dodging Palestine questions, and a glitching Tilly Norwood AI interview. Brandon closes the broadcast losing his mind to Echo the Dolphin on Genesis while his mother heckles from the hallway, ending with a raid on Avaly.
